summary: Indian stocks go into the weekend after snapping a three-day winning run on inflation worries, with US tech stocks sliding again on Friday, pointing to a cautious start on Monday.

detail.leaders: Pharma and healthcare, which held up on Friday; steady foreign buying
detail.laggards: IT and tech-linked stocks if US tech weakness persists; Eicher Motors after its profit miss
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for Monday's session. More cautious than the previous note, as the US session has turned lower with tech under pressure.
